rejection_reasons: future_graph_leakage: _enrich_features computed graph_component_size and graph_edge_density from the complete partition graph including future events
direct_label_leakage: graph_prior_suspicious_count read is_fraud from other rows
generator_fingerprint: legitimate and fraud behavior were trivially separable by construction
missing_real_rail_execution: source_command_id, source_event_id, lifecycle_state were fabricated strings not derived from Task 5 campaigns or real rail adapters
missing_latency_ece_per_family_gates: latency was null, ECE was not computed, per-family recall was not evaluated
verifier_forgery: changing status to development_ready with null latency was accepted by the old verifier
evidence_policy: Perfect metrics from this experiment cannot support model selection, readiness, or competition claims.
